name: supply chain
reason: Supply chain is the best served lens outside identity, because signing, SBOM and scanning tools exist and state their oracles. What is missing is the build side: install time execution, CI workflows triggered by outsiders, expression injection into commands, and every question about who can publish.

L10-005.note: Generating the full tree is the transitive visibility question answered directly.

L10-008.note: Signature verification is the factor, with an unsigned artefact rejected as the oracle.

L10-011.note: Inspecting what a shipped bundle actually contains is the only honest answer to vendor composition.

L10-023.note: Artefact signing and verification across the pipeline is the entry's stated function.

L10-025.note: History scanning for secrets is exactly the factor, with a hit as the oracle.

L10-030.note: Scanning a base image for known vulnerable packages answers freshness empirically.

L10-035.note: Matching an SBOM against advisories is advisory ingestion answered per artefact.

L10-051.note: Recovering original sources from a production bundle is source map publication confirmed.

L10-053.note: The count of the resolved tree is the output, which is the factor.

L10-003.note: Hygiene scoring includes namespace and registry practice. Squatting is not tested.

L10-007.note: Maintainer risk is scored. Account takeover resistance is not tested.

L10-022.note: Downgraded from L2: Log masking coverage is not the trigger and permission record. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-032.note: Abandonment is part of the score, weighted rather than answered.

L10-034.note: Disclosure practice is scored. A working path is not exercised.

L10-036.note: A pinned vulnerable version is matched by the advisory database, which is the symptom.

L10-045.note: Tool description provenance is adjacent. Runtime fetching of prompts is not tested.

L10-046.note: Config scanning finds unverified servers. Whether an agent can be pointed at one is not tested.

L10-049.note: DNS record enumeration shows delegation. Sender authentication is not tested.

L10-057.note: Branch protection is the policy half of trigger trust.

L10-004.note: A request observed during install with the control run proving the difference.

L10-020.note: A secret present or provably absent in a job started by an unprivileged actor.

L10-021.note: Interpolation into a command is the actor-controlled input half of the same test.

L10-001.note: Resolved versions diffed against the lock answers the range question.

L10-002.note: An install that ignores the lock is the failure signal.

L10-012.note: Every third party script tag carrying an integrity value is the coverage question.

L10-014.note: A modified third party file refused by the browser is the oracle.

L10-015.note: Whether a CDN can change content under the site origin is the same pin question.

L10-024.note: Lifetime and scope, demonstrated by a refused action outside the artefact.

L10-026.note: A fork or mirror still serving removed content is the test.

L10-029.note: A registry substitution attempt either fails or is recorded.

L10-039.note: A repository supplied command running on install is the config inheritance case.

L10-006.note: Dependency confusion is a resolution question: an internal name resolving publicly.

L10-009.note: Release provenance is whether a rebuild matches the published bytes.

L10-010.note: Registry token scope is the credential scope test.

L10-016.note: JSONP serving executable script from data is the same pin question.

L10-017.note: Downgraded from L2: SRI pinning and widget permission breadth are different questions. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-018.note: Build cache poisoning is an artefact that was not produced by the expected job, observed the same way as an install hook.

L10-019.note: CI runner privilege is the credential scope question on a different host.

L10-027.note: Downgraded from L2: Vendored code review is not the install hook surface. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-028.note: Update channel authentication is a credential and pin question.

L10-031.note: Image reproducibility is the same rebuild comparison.

L10-033.note: Licence exposure is a distribution obligation, already operationalised.

L10-037.note: Downgraded from L2: Generated code entering unreviewed is a review process gap, not an install hook. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-038.note: Downgraded from L2: An editor extension is not npm install time execution. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-040.note: Monorepo scope is a resolution question: which internal package is imported.

L10-041.note: Internal registry authentication is credential scope.

L10-042.note: Rebuilding without an upstream is the lock and mirror question.

L10-043.note: Downgraded from L2: Model provenance is not the lockfile resolution test. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-044.note: Downgraded from L2: A model loading code is close, but the cited entry describes package install hooks specifically. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-047.note: Downgraded from L2: Plugin update review is not the install surface. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-048.note: Downgraded from L2: Webhook target validation is application egress, not a CI trigger. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-050.note: Downgraded from L2: Certificate automation is not the deploy credential scope. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-054.note: Transitive install reach is what the install surface audit enumerates.

L10-055.note: Reproducible build verification is the same comparison.

L10-056.note: Downgraded from L2: Signed commits are not covered by the trigger test. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-058.note: Release automation authority is the credential scope test.

L10-059.note: Downgraded from L2: A vendored binary's provenance is not the lockfile test. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-060.note: Automated update merging itself is the trigger and policy question.

L10-061.note: Downgraded from L2: Namespace ownership is not the resolution drift test. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.

L10-062.note: Downgraded from L2: Enumerating exposure is a tree walk, but the cited entry is about resolved versions matching the lock. The concept is named and no procedure for it is stated.
